title: Access-controlled enterprise knowledge assistant
customer_role: Knowledge-base administrator, service operator, and compliance reviewer
business_problem: Answer operational questions from governed knowledge without exposing role-restricted content, while retaining citations and reacting correctly to updates and deletion.
inputs: books, chapters, pages, attachments, tags, revisions
human_decisions: review of sensitive or low-evidence answers
workflow_result: A generated workflow ingests authorized content, preserves ACL and revision lineage, retrieves and reranks per user identity, cites evidence, refuses unsupported answers, and updates or deletes index entries.
independent_oracle: A hidden corpus and permission matrix check answer fields, allowed and forbidden sources, citation validity, retrieval metrics, update freshness, deletion, webhook idempotency, and forbidden_chunk_count equals zero.
public_test_categories: sensitive HR refusal after reviewer rejection
page revision update and fresh citation

hidden_seed_contract.generation: Deterministic business values per Seed with a fresh attempt nonce for source and event identities; protected values are piped directly to BookStack and public workflow APIs and are not persisted in evidence.
hidden_seed_contract.fresh_host_state_per_seed: Each Seed creates a distinct BookStack book, six pages, role identities, page identities and event identities. The controlled host process is shared and reported as such.
hidden_seed_contract.pass_meaning: Every authorized answer, refusal, pre-review source, post-rejection delivery, citation, lifecycle receipt, artifact set, replay, stale rejection and host deletion agrees with the in-process sealed oracle while forbidden_chunk_count and secret-hit count remain zero.
hidden_seed_contract.claim_limit: The Seed generator and verifier are controlled-local and were authored in the same repository context, so this is sealed regression evidence rather than a third-party independent black-box audit.

capability_placement.merge_recommendation: Keep synchronization, retrieval and grounded-answer operations as one optional RAG domain module; do not add BookStack-specific blocks.

revision_semantics: Revision 1 freezes BookStack v26.05.2, the read-only service account boundary, public corpus and permission matrix, lifecycle and human-review acceptance, one-million-token ceiling for any future Lilies run, and three controlled-local sealed Seeds. The published application and all retained failures are described in the completion report.
next_action: Preserve version 1 and the controlled-local evidence. A fresh-context independent review is evidence debt for CAP-LILIES admission, not a reason to rerun the customer workflow.
